post.caption:
Slightly acidic rain erodes rock, and rivers carry the dissolved minerals downhill to the sea. When seawater evaporates the water leaves and the salt stays, and undersea vents add more. The ocean is not salty by nature. It is an accumulator that has been filling for billions of years with no drain.
